## About
Foreign Auto Hospital is an auto repair shop on Red Lion Road serving North East Philadelphia and Huntingdon Valley. We've been part of this neighborhood a long time, and we're known for honest, on time, reliable work.
We service all makes and models, whether you drive a car, truck, or SUV, but European and import repairs are where we shine. Tune-ups, AC repair, brake service, computer diagnostics, alignments and more. Come in or call for free estimates on most jobs.

## Services
- Wheel alignments: Alignment work so your car tracks straight and steers smoothly. One reviewer said their car drives perfectly straight now.
- Brake service: Pads, rotors, calipers, hoses, brake fluid flushes and parking brake repairs.
- Check engine light inspections: If your check engine light is on, bring it in and we'll inspect it and find the problem.
- Maintenance and tune-ups: Oil changes, fluid changes, tire rotation, filters, belts and hoses, plus scheduled mileage maintenance.
- Pre-purchase car inspection: Thinking of buying a used car? Have it looked over before you commit.
- Clutch slave cylinder replacement: Replacing a worn clutch slave cylinder so your clutch engages the way it should.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on foreign cars?
A: No. Imports are our specialty, but we service all makes and models, whether it's a car, truck, or SUV.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes, on most jobs. Stop in or give us a call.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I request an appointment online?
A: Yes. Use the appointment form on our site, or call us.
